test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which of the following cities has India’s first underwater train project been launched?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kolkata__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Location: The project is located in Kolkata, West Bengal.
 
• Part of the Kolkata Metro: It is a significant extension of the Kolkata Metro, specifically the East-West Metro line.
 
• Underwater Section: The train runs through a tunnel that is beneath the Hooghly River, marking a significant achievement in Indian engineering.
 
• Enhanced Connectivity: It aims to significantly reduce travel time between Kolkata and Howrah, providing a fast, efficient, and eco-friendly mode of transportation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Kolkata Metro is the first underground metro railway in India, operational since 1984.
 
• It is not just a mode of transportation but also a significant engineering marvel, showcasing advancements in tunneling and metro rail technology.
 
• The underwater metro tunnel is designed to withstand seismic activities and other natural calamities, ensuring the safety of its passengers.
 
• The project reflects India's growing capabilities in implementing complex infrastructure projects and improving urban mobility.
